title: Episode 75 — VIP, No Problem with Nima Nabavi and Bobby Lee
summary: Episode 75 is a product-development and organizational-history episode wrapped around the 2013 Middle East trip. Nima Nabavi—publicly credited as an organizer of Choe and Estevan Oriol's Dubai presentation—rejoins the group and describes his family's manufacturing capabilities. The cast calls him Dr. Nima, but he says he is not a doctor. That distinction matters because the conversation moves from reverse engineering into pheromones, acne, isotretinoin, Botox, CBD, probiotics, hair loss, essential oils, diet and other health claims. The central prototype is an unknown topical mixture said to contain androstenes. Participants interpret smiles, dates, relationship changes and a dog's behavior as proof, propose covert tests, apply it heavily and imagine a commercial line. The editorial map treats those as anecdotes shaped by odor, expectation and context—not controlled evidence. It rejects genital use, exposure without ingredient disclosure, testing on dates, workers, clients or animals, and every joke implying a chemical can create consent. The episode also records the earliest direct-to-fan DVDASA store and recruitment plans, Nima's decade-long Choe merchandise connection, his Eddie Huang book claim, the disability art project, a North Korean restaurant visit, and the show's growing tension between informal friendship and an actual workplace. A detailed Beirut story is preserved only at a high level because its venue, code phrase, room, handlers and route would form an exploitation playbook. Named dialogue remains withheld.
sensitivity: Commercial sex and trafficking-adjacent logistics; unknown topical product and covert behavioral testing; rape jokes; disabled and neurodivergent children; DPRK overseas workers and forced labor; medical, drug, nutrition and product misinformation; client-worker sexual boundary; employment discrimination and retaliation; racial, national, disability, orientation and gender slurs; drug manufacture; self-harm hyperbole; private partners, dates and family business.
speaker_policy: Named dialogue remains withheld. Episode 75 has zero diarized turns and five coarse window embeddings for a changing ensemble. Public participants are contextually known, but no independently held-out multispeaker validation has passed.
